verdict.rationale: uv's lockfile is explicitly documented as cross-platform, and it ships standalone installers (curl-based) plus pip installation, with consistent CLI commands (`uv add`, `uv run`, `uv tool install`, etc.) that work the same way regardless of OS. Community comments corroborate a consistent, fast workflow but don't specifically stress-test Windows parity. Missing for 10: explicit Windows-specific documentation/testing, independent hands-on confirmation of identical behavior across macOS/Linux/Windows, and any discussion of platform-specific quirks.
